title: UV/material carrier on GeometryBundle and textured HalfEdgeMesh rendering
description: Give the pipeline a home for textures. HalfEdgeMesh and ArrayMesh carry positions and normals only; the only UV notion is the parametric UvField, and the only textured draw path is AssimpModelRuntime's procedural checker. Define the texture data model as GeometryBundle slots: the per-vertex UV slot from CRAW-1 plus a material slot (a plain MaterialData class with public final fields: base-color image bytes/width/height, metallic-roughness image, factors) decoded from the GLB's embedded PNGs through the Platform image loader (stbi_load_from_memory already exists in HeadlessPlatform/LwjglPlatform; expose it on the Platform interface, no LWJGL in graphics). Add a TEXTURED mode to HalfEdgeMeshRuntime that uploads the base-color Texture and samples it via the existing MeshShader useTexture path, falling back to solid colour when the slot is missing. Slots must survive the representation-preserving ops in data/ops (merge_by_distance, delete) or fail loudly. This supersedes the pipeline half of ENG-10 (which targets the render-only Assimp path); the user decides whether ENG-10 is closed as superseded.
definition-of-done: 1. Loading a crawfish GLB yields a bundle with UV and material slots; the material slot holds both decoded PNGs. 2. mesh-viewer renders the scan with its own base-color texture (run-scene screenshot shows the photographic crawfish colouring, not the checker). 3. Toggle key in the model scene switches TEXTURED / FLAT / tag modes; ControlHint lists it. 4. Slot names are owned by exactly one constant (on MaterialData / the UV field owner), never raw strings at use sites. 5. join_geometry, transform_geometry, mirror_geometry and merge_by_distance carry the new slots (or throw with a clear message where impossible). 6. Build checkstyle-green; existing mesh tests pass.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test: a two-triangle bundle with a 2x2 RGBA material slot round-trips through transform_geometry and mirror_geometry with UVs intact. 2. Unit test: HalfEdgeMeshRuntime mode selection falls back to solid when no material slot is present (headless GL). 3. run-scene mesh-viewer on IMG_4109.glb, screenshot, visually confirm texture; `ixdar-cli mesh-state` reports the slots. 4. TeaVM build still green (image decode stays behind the platform interface).
todos: Add MaterialData value class and slot constant; decode embedded PNGs via Platform image loading
Expose image-from-memory decode on the Platform interface (headless + LWJGL implementations)
Add TEXTURED mode to HalfEdgeMeshRuntime using the existing Texture and MeshShader useTexture uniform
Carry UV/material slots through data/ops and the modifier nodes that rebuild bundles
Add a mode toggle key + ControlHint to ModelScene-based scenes
Write the two unit tests and the run-scene screenshot check
Note ENG-10 overlap in changes-made for the user's decision
unknowns: Per-vertex vs per-corner UVs: glTF is per-vertex, but booleans/quad extraction may need per-corner seams later (CRAW-14)
Whether metallic-roughness should be sampled now or stored only
Whether the material slot should be a Field type per REFACTOR-PLAN-2 C6 or a plain value class (it is not per-element data)
